summary.text: A short mountain in Fang Yuan's sovereign immortal aperture Mini Southern Border, named for a Gu formation that seals his original immortal zombie body and later heaven's will.

claims.text: The mountain is short and uninspiring. Fang Yuan modifies the peak with a huge Gu formation; the interior is empty and seals an immortal zombie body. That body is six meters tall, with a miniature pair of bat wings, a green face and sharp fangs, shut eyes, and eight different arms spread like a peacock’s tail with fingers stabbed into the ground.

In Mini Southern Border of the sovereign immortal aperture, a strength path immortal zombie under Fang Yuan’s control lands on a small mountain that he names Heaven Sealing Mountain. The name is grand, but the mountain is short. Light from the sealing Gu formation blows on the sealed original immortal zombie body like a clear breeze.

Sovereign immortal aperture, Mini Southern Border, Heaven Sealing Mountain. It is called Heaven Sealing Mountain because it was meant to seal heaven’s will. Fang Yuan’s sovereign immortal body floats in the air looking down at it while Sixth Hair stands beside him. Waves of white light soak the mountain like flowing water until a golden light pillar penetrates it and stabs into its core.

Heaven Sealing Mountain is empty after Fang Yuan’s immortal zombie body, carrying his split soul as a rank six time path clone, is no longer sealed there. Great thief ghost hand enters the cave inside the mountain and into the Gu formation under his manipulation.
